capabilities: display a customizable dashboard homepage with themes, banners and module ordering
create, filter and link tasks across sections with six task levels
show life modules for calendar, weather, countdowns, Pomodoro and recent files
store dashboard and task data as Markdown/JSON inside the vault
activate a paid license with offline license support
extras: Paid plugin requiring a purchased license; unactivated it shows a read-only homepage preview. Source code is in a private repository, only release builds go through community review. README is mostly in Chinese. Documents network access and privacy terms (no telemetry) and stores data in A_Shared_Data and A_Dashboard_Data vault folders.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in home dashboard that pulls tasks, plans, notes, schedules and daily-life widgets together on a single page.
summary: License-activated dashboard homepage that combines kanban, tasks, plans, calendar, weather, countdowns, Pomodoro and progress tracking in one view.
